strings:
Written for Noctiluca's corpus: a news front page with pictures where
     the page puts them, captions, a video with a poster, an animated GIF and
     a grid of stories. Every picture is the fixture's own (media/make.py).
Boats at anchor in the harbour at night, with the town's lights on the water
The bay glows blue for a third night as the bloom spreads along the coast
Crowds gathered on the quay to watch the waves light up as they broke.
Watch: the bloom from the air
Market traders return to the square
Storms expected across the north tonight
Animated: the tide rolling in under the moon
Why the tides are higher this week
Green hills under a low sun
A warm end to the month
